measurement_scope: Six timed stages, including the failed training attempt and CPU setup within each timer. This is process wall time, not GPU busy time; separate initial tensor smoke and environment setup were not timed.
allowance_note: One whole-card GPU-hour is a conservative accounting allowance for this short extension, including untimed setup, smoke and idle. It is neither a measured GPU-hour count nor a billed charge; no utilization/VRAM-share discount is applied.
